response.original_title: Still Standing: Connecticut's Living Symbol of Freedom and Legacy
response.overview: Explore the White Oak, Connecticut’s living symbol of freedom and legacy. This historic tree stands as a powerful reminder of the Charter Oak’s role in protecting Connecticut’s independence and continues to represent resilience, strength, and the enduring spirit of the state. In this documentary, we take a closer look at the story behind the White Oak, its significance in Connecticut history, and why it remains an important natural and cultural landmark today. Discover how nature and history intertwine in this iconic tree that has inspired generations and preserved a story of courage and identity.
